entry.title: Article 2: Authorize short-term borrowing in anticipation of FY2026 revenue: Finance Committee, 2025-04-03
entry.summary: Article 2 - borrowing in anticipation of revenue. A new fail-safe article to allow the town to borrow if there is a cash-flow shortfall from revenues not coming in as expected; select board recommended it at 50.

entry.title: Article 2: Authorize short-term borrowing in anticipation of FY2026 revenue: Lunenburg Water District, 2025-01-08
entry.summary: Cash and short-term borrowing. Cash rose at year end and short-term borrowing for the water main project rose by a similar amount; the district earned interest on the cash.

entry.title: Article 2: Authorize short-term borrowing in anticipation of FY2026 revenue: Lunenburg Water District, 2024-11-13
entry.summary: A resident asked about borrowing costs and rates for the short-term and long-term options, whether there is a prepayment penalty, and whether interest rates will drop.
